baseline_models.focus_anchor: The repeated interrogative construction around the causative knowing verb at word 2 and the event-name at words 4-5.
baseline_models.mechanism: The verse names the event while asking what could cause the addressee to know it. Knowing is therefore granted at the level of identity but withheld at the level of adequate measure; the severe event-day and decisive judgment branches make that mismatch functional rather than merely rhetorical.

activation_trace.role: Knowing and causing another to know anchors the verse as an epistemic challenge directed at the event.
A severe event-day makes the noun denote a momentous occurrence rather than an ordinary daylight interval.
A ruling that separates truth from falsehood supplies the event's decisive normative operation.

changed_reading.before: A request for a definition of a named future day.
changed_reading.after: An epistemic threshold: the event can be named as decisive judgment, but its scale cannot be contained by the addressee's prior knowledge.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The genitive construction at words 4-5, with the separation noun governing the kind of event-day in view.
baseline_models.mechanism: Basic separation makes a limit appear, while detailing clarifies parts and meanings. The event is thus not only a verdict imposed after facts are known; it is the occasion on which formerly obscured boundaries become perceptible and the whole is resolved into intelligible parts.

activation_trace.role: The branch of a major occurrence supplies the temporal occasion on which disclosure happens.
Separation that exposes the line between things makes boundary-visibility the event's core action.
Detailing by setting out parts turns separation into clarification rather than bare division.

changed_reading.before: The day simply divides two classes by verdict.
changed_reading.after: The day actively makes hidden distinctions visible and explains the whole by resolving its parts.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The pairing of an open span of time at word 4 with the joint-between-parts branch at word 5.
baseline_models.mechanism: A joint both distinguishes parts and is where they meet. Read temporally, the named event can be an articulation point at which one order ends, another begins, and their relation is exposed, rather than a date that is merely isolated from surrounding time.

activation_trace.role: An open span of time permits an epochal phase rather than requiring one solar day.
A joint between parts supplies the articulation point where temporal orders divide and meet.

changed_reading.before: A bounded date on which separation happens.
changed_reading.after: An epochal joint whose arrival de-articulates the present order and articulates what follows.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening chain moves from successive dispatch through violent scattering and spreading to explicit discrimination, then to casting a reminder. This makes the focus event the culmination of an active sorting-and-disclosure process already in motion, not an isolated judicial label.

activation_trace.role: Boundary-producing separation anchors the opening sequence back in the focus event.
Succession punctuated by cuts supplies a staged dispatch whose intervals anticipate separation.
A forceful wind that lifts and scatters things supplies the physical disaggregation phase.
Opening, spreading, and branching make dispersed contents available for distinction.
Discriminating between two things supplies the sequence's explicit sorting operation.
Casting something forth turns the resulting reminder into a delivered intervention.
A reminder that makes one recollect supplies the epistemic product of the sorting chain.

structural_cues: 77:1-5 is a coordinated participial sequence, with paired verbal-noun reinforcement in 77:2-4.
77:6 closes the sequence with the alternative of excuse or warning before 77:7 asserts fulfillment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an ordered chain of dispatch, scattering, spreading, discrimination, and reminder; I infer a preparatory arrow from that chain to the focus event. A live alternative is that the clauses describe independent agents or actions rather than stages of one process.

changed_reading.before: A future judgment that begins when its date arrives.
changed_reading.after: The terminal disclosure of a sorting process that has already been dispatched, dispersed, unfolded, distinguished, and announced.

context_deltas.mechanism: The promised event is fixed to an appointment and then represented through erased lights, an opened sky, and mountains removed from place. The day of separation becomes a timed material de-articulation of the world's present boundaries as well as a verdict within them.

activation_trace.role: The severe occasion branch anchors the cosmic changes in one momentous event.
The joint-between-parts image lets cosmic transformations register as de-articulation of an order.
A promise bounded by time or place supplies the event's appointed horizon.
A severe occurrence that befalls converts appointment into realized impact.
Erasure of a trace supplies the removal of celestial markers.
A fissure opening between things supplies the sky's loss of continuity.
Uprooting and removal from place supplies the mountains' displacement.
Fixing something to a time or terminus synchronizes the messengers with the event.
A prescribed temporal limit supplies the endpoint of postponement.
Boundary-revealing separation names the appointment to which the transformations converge.

structural_cues: 77:8-11 repeats conditional openings followed by passive transformations.
The question in 77:12 receives the short answer in 77:13 and then the focus verse reopens that answer as an epistemic problem.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an appointment and a sequence of cosmic transformations; I infer that these changes materially instantiate separation. A live alternative is that they are only portents preceding a distinct judicial event.

changed_reading.before: A courtroom-like judgment conducted within a stable cosmos.
changed_reading.after: An appointed event that judges by dismantling the very articulations and markers of the present cosmos.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier and later peoples form a succession; embryonic life rests in a stable lodging until a measured limit; earth gathers living and dead. Across these scales, temporary containment gives way to succession or release, strengthening separation as the terminal exposure of an ordering already active in history, gestation, and burial.

activation_trace.role: An open temporal span permits the focus event to gather long historical and life-cycle processes.
Separation that exposes boundaries supplies the release and sorting operation shared across the cycles.
Beginning and precedence establish the earlier side of historical succession.
Following in sequence supplies continuity from one historical cohort to the next.
Laterness after what came first establishes the second side of the historical boundary.
Stability and settled rest supply the temporary gestational enclosure.
A quantity reaching its limit supplies the enclosure's measured terminus.
Gathering and gripping within a container makes earth a holding structure.
Animate life supplies one class held by the earth.
Loss of life and force supplies the opposed class held in the same earth.

structural_cues: 77:16-18, 77:20-23, and 77:25-27 are parallel evidentiary blocks separated by the recurring woe refrain.
The blocks move across historical succession, gestational duration, and earth's simultaneous holding of living and dead.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies succession, stable gestational lodging until a limit, and earth as container; I infer a common containment-to-release pattern culminating in the focus event. A live alternative is that the blocks are separate proofs of power without one shared material mechanism.

changed_reading.before: A final sorting imposed only at the end of history.
changed_reading.after: The terminal disclosure of a measured containment-and-release order already legible in generations, gestation, life, and death.

context_deltas.mechanism: One group is driven toward a three-branched appearance of shade that neither shelters nor suffices against flame; the protected are placed in actual shades and springs. Separation is spatially and materially enacted through opposed environments, including a counterfeit refuge that advertises the function it cannot perform.

activation_trace.role: Boundary-making separation anchors the opposed destinations in the focus event.
Unimpeded departure supplies forced movement from verdict toward destination.
Shade as covering supplies the promised function of the first destination's refuge.
Shelter and protective cover supply the realized function available at the opposed destination.
Branching and divergence give the false refuge its split form without granting protection.
Sufficiency names the protective capacity explicitly denied to the false shade.
The tongue and blaze of fire supplies the threat the false covering cannot block.
Repelling harm by protection identifies the disposition aligned with effective shelter.
A flowing spring supplies life-giving material abundance at the protected destination.

structural_cues: 77:29-31 commands movement to a shade and immediately negates that shade's sheltering and protective functions.
77:41 answers with a compact positive location phrase placing the protected in shades and springs.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies lexically matched shade scenes with opposite efficacy; I infer that the spatial contrast enacts the focus separation. A live alternative is that the scenes describe only consequences after a separation completed elsewhere.

changed_reading.before: A verdict that verbally classifies people.
changed_reading.after: A material partition that routes people into environments distinguished by whether apparent shelter actually protects and sustains.

context_deltas.mechanism: Excuse, speech, permission, assembly, and strategy form a procedural scene in which defendants lose the means to articulate or negotiate while the judgment itself articulates the distinction. The focus separation therefore operates as closure of adversarial discourse, not merely its successful conclusion.

activation_trace.role: An articulating tongue that distinguishes matters lets judgment itself perform the speech denied to the assembled.
Excuse and exculpation supply the defense act that cannot proceed.
Speech and articulation supply the human capacity explicitly suspended.
Permission to act supplies the procedural authorization explicitly withheld.
A day or summons gathering people supplies the comprehensive assembly before judgment.
Strategic contrivance supplies the residual agency challenged after speech and excuse are closed.

structural_cues: 77:35-36 uses coordinated negations to remove speech and permission for excuse.
77:38 names the day again while gathering current and earlier peoples, followed by the conditional challenge in 77:39.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies silenced speech, withheld permission, blocked excuse, total assembly, and a challenge to strategy; I infer that judgment becomes the articulating agent. A live alternative is that the silence describes only one phase and does not redefine the focus noun's speech branch.

changed_reading.before: A hearing in which claims are weighed and then separated.
changed_reading.after: A procedural closure where human articulation, excuse, and maneuver cease, so the judgment itself speaks the decisive distinction.

context_deltas.mechanism: Intentional work is met by corresponding recompense and good action, while culpability is paired with enjoyment explicitly reduced in duration. Separation thus reveals not only different labels but different temporal yields of action: fitting recompense on one side and rapidly exhausted benefit on the other.

activation_trace.role: Judgment distinguishing truth from falsehood anchors the opposed yields of action in adjudication.
Wrongdoing and offense supply the culpable basis of the shortened enjoyment.
Intentional action supplies the input to the outcome relation.
Answering an act with its recompense supplies the directional link from deed to outcome.
Doing what is good qualifies the action whose recompense is affirmed.
Pleasurable benefit supplies the apparent positive yield on the culpable side.
Smallness and paucity contract that benefit and expose its temporal insufficiency.

structural_cues: 77:43-44 links welcome consumption to prior action and explicit recompense.
77:46 reuses the consumption register as a curtailed imperative for the culpable, creating a sharp temporal contrast.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies deed-to-recompense language and explicitly little enjoyment; I infer that duration is one axis on which the focus event separates outcomes. A live alternative is that 'little' is only rhetorical disparagement and not part of the separating mechanism.

changed_reading.before: A binary verdict that assigns reward or punishment.
changed_reading.after: A disclosure of what actions actually yield, including the unequal durability of apparently similar enjoyment.

context_deltas.mechanism: A spoken command fails to produce bodily bowing, and the final question asks what later discourse could produce heart-settled assent. These endpoints revise the focus question from a request for additional information into a diagnosis of the limit of discourse when reception does not become embodied submission.

activation_trace.role: Knowing and causing another to know anchors the contextual diagnosis in the focus question's epistemic verb.
Articulating speech supplies the verbal disclosure whose reception is being tested.
Uttered speech supplies an instruction that has already reached its hearers.
Humility and submission supply the embodied response that speech fails to produce.
Renewed report or discourse supplies the hypothetical additional message whose efficacy is doubted.
Temporal laterness tests whether any subsequent discourse could change the response.
Assent that settles the heart supplies the reception absent despite articulated warning.

structural_cues: 77:48 places a passive speech event in a conditional frame and answers it with bodily nonresponse.
The final interrogative in 77:50 echoes the focus verse's interrogative form while shifting from knowing to believing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies spoken command without bowing and a final challenge about later discourse producing assent; I infer that adequate knowing requires receptive embodiment. A live alternative is that these verses diagnose stubborn denial without revising the semantics of the focus epistemic formula.

changed_reading.before: The addressee lacks enough information to comprehend the event.
changed_reading.after: The question also exposes a receptive limit: further speech cannot cause knowing when articulated warning never becomes settled assent and embodied submission.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's split mapping of the focus knowing root together with a topographic branch of the separation root. It remains anchored in explicit focus branches and is activated by the surah's irrigation, sweet water, and spring images; downstream prose should present it only as a cross-domain routing analogy, never as the lexical meaning of the focus verb.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus knowing root's alternate mapped branches of abundant issuing and directional course, combined with the separation root's channel-through-terrain branch.

activation_trace.role: Abundant issuing from a source supplies the event's overwhelming release image.
A road or wind-course supplies direction and routing to that release.
A gap or channel through mountain or sand supplies the separated route through which flow passes.
Water appearing and becoming abundant activates the focus image of issuing from a source.
An allotted irrigation share and its channel supply controlled distribution rather than undirected flow.
Fresh sweet water supplies the life-giving quality of one routed outcome.
A flowing spring supplies the destination at which routed abundance emerges.

changed_reading.before: The focus formula only magnifies an unknowable judgment.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it evokes an overwhelming release routed through newly opened channels into distinct outcomes, with separation functioning like hydrological distribution.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it carries a concrete nursing/weaning branch into eschatological process. It remains anchored in the focus separation root and is unusually reinforced by creation from reproductive fluid, stable lodging, a measured term, and earth as container; downstream prose should call it a gestational analogy, not assert that the event-name literally means birth or weaning.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus separation noun through its branch for offspring separated from mother or nursing.

activation_trace.role: Weaning or separating offspring from maternal support supplies the release-from-enclosure model.
Bringing a creature into existence supplies the life-process entering containment.
Reproductive fluid in the womb supplies the maternal and gestational material of the analogy.
Stable settlement supplies the protected enclosure before release.
Reaching a measured limit supplies maturation and the terminus of enclosure.
A container that gathers and grips extends the gestational pattern from womb to earth.

changed_reading.before: The event externally sorts completed persons.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the event is a collective weaning from the present world's enclosing supports when their measured term reaches maturity.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it treats the surah's form as an activation of the event-name rather than only describing the event's referent. It remains anchored in the focus branches for formal textual separators and clarifying detail, together with the repeated denial refrain; downstream prose should describe a compositional enactment or echo, not equate the eschatological event with verse endings.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus separation noun through its formal separator and clarifying-detail branches, activated by the refrain that divides successive evidentiary scenes.

activation_trace.role: Formal separators regulating text and cadence supply a compositional version of the focus operation.
Clarifying a whole by distinguishing its parts supplies the refrain-divided structure's explanatory function.
Opposition to truth supplies the refrain's recurring object at its first post-focus occurrence.
The same truth-opposition at the refrain's final occurrence marks the long sequence of separated scenes.

changed_reading.before: The focus verse merely names a future separating event.
changed_reading.after: The surah formally rehearses that event: recurring refrain-boundaries separate and clarify successive proofs, destinations, and responses.

strongest_changes: The opening participial chain turns the event from an isolated verdict into the culmination of an already active dispatch, dispersal, sorting, and reminder process.
The appointed cosmic sequence makes separation a material de-articulation of the present world, while opposed shade scenes make it a spatial allocation into effective and counterfeit refuge.
The speech, bowing, and final discourse sequence shifts the focus epistemic question from missing information toward the limits of reception and embodied assent.
The silenced assembly activates a reversal in which judgment itself articulates the distinction after human speech, excuse, and strategy are closed.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah package activated mechanisms unavailable in the focus alone: long-range lexical reversals, repeated evidentiary blocks, the refrain as a formal separator, and the final echo from knowing to believing. The split mapping of the focus knowing root also supported one contained hydraulic outlier without displacing the ordinary epistemic reading.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the cosmic transformations instantiate the separating event or serve only as signs immediately before it.
Whether the gestational, hydraulic, and compositional models are intended resonances or productive branch-driven analogies.
Whether the focus epistemic formula primarily marks incommensurable scale, resistant reception, or both as coexisting readings.
